class Solution:
    def countNonDecreasingSubarrays(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        if n == 0:
            return 0

        nge = [n] * n
        st = []
        for i, v in enumerate(nums):
            while st and v > nums[st[-1]]:
                nge[st.pop()] = i
            st.append(i)

        pref = array('Q', [0] * (n + 1))
        for i in range(n):
            pref[i + 1] = pref[i] + nums[i]

        S = array('Q', [0] * n)
        for i in range(n):
            j = nge[i]
            S[i] = (j - i - 1) * nums[i] - (pref[j] - pref[i + 1])

        bits = n.bit_length() + 1
        up = [array('I', [n] * (n + 1)) for _ in range(bits)]
        sumS = [array('Q', [0] * (n + 1)) for _ in range(bits)]
        last = [array('I', [0] * (n + 1)) for _ in range(bits)]

        for i in range(n):
            up[0][i] = nge[i]
            sumS[0][i] = S[i]
            last[0][i] = i
        up[0][n] = n
        sumS[0][n] = 0
        last[0][n] = n

        for b in range(1, bits):
            up_bm1 = up[b - 1]
            up_b = up[b]
            sum_bm1 = sumS[b - 1]
            sum_b = sumS[b]
            last_bm1 = last[b - 1]
            last_b = last[b]
            for i in range(n + 1):
                mid = up_bm1[i]
                up_b[i] = up_bm1[mid]
                sum_b[i] = sum_bm1[i] + sum_bm1[mid]
                if mid != n:
                    last_b[i] = last_bm1[mid]
                else:
                    last_b[i] = last_bm1[i]

        def cost_query(l: int, R: int) -> int:
            B = R + 1
            cur = l
            total = 0
            last_included = -1
            for b in range(bits - 1, -1, -1):
                if cur < n:
                    nxt = up[b][cur]
                    if nxt <= B:
                        total += sumS[b][cur]
                        last_included = last[b][cur]
                        cur = nxt
            base = last_included if last_included != -1 else l
            total += (R - base) * nums[base] - (pref[R + 1] - pref[base + 1])
            return total

        ans = 0
        r = 0
        for l in range(n):
            while r < n and cost_query(l, r) <= k:
                r += 1
            ans += r - l
            if r == l:
                r += 1
        return ans
